**STEP 1 - Scene:** A lunch-style plate with a square of baked lasagna (marinara sauce and grated cheese) and a half bread roll. Photographed from above at a slight angle.

**STEP 2 - Ruler:** White ridged plate, about 22 cm across (side-plate sized). Area = 3.14 × (11)² ≈ 380 cm².

**STEP 3 - Items:** (1) lasagna square with sauce and grated cheese; (2) half bread roll.

**STEP 4 - Area:** Lasagna footprint ≈ 56 cm², about 15% of the plate. Bread roll ≈ 30 cm², about 8%. Food covers about 23% of the plate.

**STEP 5 - Volume:** Lasagna ≈ 56 cm² × 4 cm ≈ 224 ml. Bread roll ≈ 110 ml (dome-shaped piece).

**STEP 6 - Grams:** Lasagna 224 ml × 0.9 ≈ 200 g. Bread 110 ml × 0.3 ≈ 35–40 g, so 40 g.

**STEP 7 - Energy:** Lasagna ≈ 140 kcal/100 g → 280 kcal. Bread roll ≈ 270 kcal/100 g → about 108 kcal.

**STEP 8 - Sanity check:** About 240 g total and about 390 kcal is plausible for one lasagna square plus half a roll on a side plate.
